subtitle: (Last Sura Revealed)*
text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious,
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: When triumph comes from GOD, and victory.
footnote_1981: *110:1-3 This last sura, chronologically, consists of 19 Arabic words (see 96:1), and the first verse consists of 19 letters. This indicates that this generation of believers shall attain the promised victory. Submission (true Islam) will prevail throughout the world (48:28).

text_1981: You will see the people embracing GOD's religion in throngs.
text_1989: You will see the people embracing GOD’s religion in throngs.
